title: review: Secret-scanner hygiene: replace credential-shaped test fixtures with shapes no detector matches, and document the fixture rule
spec:
GitGuardian reported "1 secret uncovered" on PR 19 (head 6ca204e8). The only credential-shaped strings in that range are test fixtures: tests/test_evidence.py (a raw string containing an API_TOKEN assignment with a made-up value, used to prove evidence.make redacts before persisting) and tests/test_jev_boundary.py (a made-up value assigned to `secret` and joined into an API_KEY assignment to prove jev_rank redacts before sending). They are not credentials, but they trip generic detectors on every scan.
Do:
1. In both tests build the fixture at runtime so no literal assignment of the form NAME=value with a secret-looking value exists in the source: e.g. compose the key name and the value from separate parts ("API_" + "TOKEN", value = "fixture-" + "0" * 24) or read them from a helper `tests/_fixtures.py::fake_secret(label)` that returns a clearly labelled non-secret value with enough length for jev.redact's rules to trigger (the 32+ char hex/base64 rule or the NAME=value rule). The assertions keep proving redaction (the value must be absent from the outgoing payload and present in the untouched input).
2. Add `.gitguardian.yaml` at the repo root with `paths-ignore` for tests/_fixtures.py only and a comment explaining that test fixtures never contain real secrets and are built at runtime; do not ignore whole test directories.
3. docs/context-economy/04-jev-boundary.md: add a two-line "Fixtures" note (how to write redaction tests without tripping scanners).
Tests: tests/test_jev_boundary.py and tests/test_evidence.py stay green; add tests/test_fixtures.py::test_fake_secret_has_no_literal_secret_shape_in_source (grep the two test files and tests/_fixtures.py for the regex (?i)(api[_-]?key|token|secret|password)\s*=\s*['"][A-Za-z0-9/+_-]{12,} and assert no match). Never quote double-brace placeholder tokens literally. Do not ask questions.
acceptance: .gitguardian.yaml exists with paths-ignore limited to tests/_fixtures.py; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0

result.summary: Verified against live repo: fixtures are built at runtime (no literal NAME=quoted-value assignments), jev.redact's KEY=VALUE pattern (index 3, any \S+) still catches the fixture values regardless of shape, so test_evidence.py and test_jev_boundary.py assertions hold. Ran the actual suite (python3 -m unittest discover on tests/test_evidence.py, test_jev_boundary.py, test_fixtures.py) — all pass. Full tests-green.sh gate also green (1123 tests). .gitguardian.yaml scopes paths-ignore to tests/_fixtures.py only, doc note added, new self-check regex doesn't false-positive on its own source line. No issues found.
